title: Prescribed normalized CE presentations and the first-page computation
statement: For every scheme $X$ and bounded-below integer cochain complex $K$ of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], prescribe an augmented bicomplex $a(X,K):K\to I(X,K)$ with complex degrees in $\mathbb Z$ and resolution degrees in $\mathbb N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Assume individual lower bounds in complex degree, injectivity of all terms and all horizontal cycle, boundary and homology terms, and quasi-isomorphisms on augmented rows and on their horizontal cycle, boundary and homology complexes. There exist simultaneous presentations $P(X,K)$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation] retaining $P(X,K).I=I(X,K)$, representative differential data $\delta(X,K,r)$ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], and complex isomorphisms $j_r:P(X,K).sequence.page(r)\cong\delta(X,K,r).page$ for $r\ge1$. Transporting the successor homology comparison through $j_r$ and $j_{r+1}$ gives a normalized comparison [lem-sp-filtered-complex-normalized-homology]. For $f:Y\to X$, complexes $K,L$, and $v:f^{-1}K\to L$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], supply a bicomplex comparison $\varphi$, its degree-zero augmentation equation, and a sheaf-total map $u$ with the nonnegative diagonal summand equations of the Lean statement. Put $b=P(X,K).totalSectionsIso.hom\,ceSectionsLift(f,u)\,P(Y,L).totalSectionsIso.inv$ [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison] and assume it restricts to every filtration step. Every map $M$ between the first-page complexes which carries filtered cycle representatives according to $b$ satisfies $M^{q,p}firstPageIso_{Y,L}=firstPageIso_{X,K}(Sheaf.H.map(v^q,p)\circ cohomologyMap(f,K^q,p))$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. The representative condition is the equation displayed in Lean, using $j_1^{-1}$ and actual boundary-cokernel projections. This statement asserts no spectral-sequence map or existence of maps on higher pages.

proof.text: Form the degreewise finite flipped sections total, its second filtration and the augmentation, resolution comparison and transported homology-image filtration on the prescribed I,a. Retain the prescribed I, rather than choosing another CE resolution.

Use actual boundary cokernels and the unique representative differential on every positive page. Use the unique normalized successor comparison. Adjoin the graded page zero with its homology comparison; retain the signed row computation.

Choose ordinaryComparison through the explicit Ext-to-sections identification, comparing each prescribed injective row with the chosen resolution. Its coefficient naturality fills ordinary_naturality. The diagonal equation computes the graded map as the sections pullback unit followed by the row map; the augmentation equation identifies the resulting homology map with Ext pullback followed by the coefficient map. The equal signed factors commute with the additive map and cancel.

For an arbitrary first-page map M satisfying the representative equation, use an epic cover of graded cycles by filtered representatives. The target graded-cycle inclusion is monic and the page projection epic, so M equals the row map just computed. This statement does not construct a compatible sequence of higher-page maps.

      HomologicalComplex₂ (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      ((CochainComplex.single₀
        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
         (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ I X K)
    (hbelow : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero ((I X K).X s))
    (hrows : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ), QuasiIso ((a X K).f s))
    (hterms : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective (((I X K).X s).X r))
    (hhorizontal : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ),
      Injective (((I X K).cycles s).X r) ∧
      Injective ((image ((I X K).d (s - 1) s)).X r) ∧
      Injective (((I X K).homology s).X r))
    (hquasi : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ),
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (a X K) s) ∧
      QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' ((a X K).f (s - 1)) ((a X K).f s)
        ((a X K).comm (s - 1) s))) ∧
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (a X K) s)) :
    ∃ (P : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (δ : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
        FilteredComplexPageDifferential (P X K).sectionsTotal (P X K).L r)
      (j : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r), (P X K).sequence.page r hr ≅ (δ X K r hr).page),

        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),

      (∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
        FilteredComplexHomologyNormalized (P X K).sectionsTotal (P X K).L r (δ X K r hr) pq

            (ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)) pq).mapIso (j X K r hr).symm ≪≫
            (P X K).sequence.iso r (r + 1) pq rfl hr ≪≫
            (HomologicalComplex.eval AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}
              (ComplexShape.up' (r + 1, 1 - (r + 1))) pq).mapIso
                (j X K (r + 1) (by omega)))) ∧
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
    (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
    (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
      let D := P X K
      let D' := P Y L
      ∀ (φ : (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D.I ⟶ D'.I)
    (hφ : ∀ q : ℤ,
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).map
          ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (K.obj.X q)).inv ≫
            (D.a.f q).f 0) ≫ (φ.f q).f 0 =
        v.f q ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (L.obj.X q)).inv ≫
            (D'.a.f q).f 0)
    (u : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D.sheafTotal ⟶ D'.sheafTotal)
    (hu : ∀ (m : ℕ) (q n : ℤ) (h : (m : ℤ) + q = n),
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).map
            ((HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
              (((𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (D.I.X q))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := m) (i' := (m : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
                (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor
                  (𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))).obj
                    D.I).flip).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) q n h) ≫ u.f n =
          (φ.f q).f m ≫
            (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
              (((𝟭 (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (D'.I.X q))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := m) (i' := (m : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
                (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor
                  (𝟭 (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))).obj
                    D'.I).flip).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) q n h),
      let b := D.totalSectionsIso.hom ≫ ceSectionsLift f u ≫ D'.totalSectionsIso.inv
      (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ s : (D.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ) ⟶
          (D'.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ),
        s ≫ (D'.L.step q).arrow = (D.L.step q).arrow ≫ b) →
      ∀ M : D.sequence.page 1 ⟶ D'.sequence.page 1,
        (∀ (A : AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) (q p : ℤ)

          (y : A ⟶ (D'.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ).X (q + p))
          (z : A ⟶ (D.L.complexCycles q (q + p) 1 : AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
          (z' : A ⟶ (D'.L.complexCycles q (q + p) 1 : AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),

            y ≫ (D'.L.step q).arrow.f (q + p) →
          z ≫ (D.L.complexCycles q (q + p) 1).arrow =
            x ≫ (D.L.complexQuotientπ q (q + 1) (by omega)).f (q + p) →
          z' ≫ (D'.L.complexCycles q (q + p) 1).arrow =
            y ≫ (D'.L.complexQuotientπ q (q + 1) (by omega)).f (q + p) →
          z ≫ filteredComplexPageπ D.sectionsTotal D.L 1 (q, p) ≫
              (j X K 1 (by omega)).inv.f (q, p) ≫ M.f (q, p) =
            z' ≫ filteredComplexPageπ D'.sectionsTotal D'.L 1 (q, p) ≫
              (j Y L 1 (by omega)).inv.f (q, p)) →
        ∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
          M.f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ (D'.firstPageIso p q).hom =
            (D.firstPageIso p q).hom ≫
